CreateRoute.routeName: Route name, 2–64 characters, unique within the same instance
CreateRoute.srcProduct: Source product identifier, no need to fill in for external users
CreateRoute.accessMode: Access mode, either API or Web, defaults to API
CreateRoute.webSubdomain: Standalone subdomain for Web mode, required when accessMode is Web
CreateRoute.servicePath: Backend service path for Web mode, required when accessMode is Web, must start with `/`
CreateRoute.domains: List of custom domains bound in API mode; uses instance default domain when empty
CreateRoute.matchRules: Route matching rules; Web mode must use prefix match on `/`
CreateRoute.matchRules.pathRule: Path rule, contains matchType, value, and caseSensitive
CreateRoute.matchRules.headers: Request header matching rules, each item contains key, matchType, and value
CreateRoute.matchRules.queryParams: Query parameter matching rules, each item contains key, matchType, and value
CreateRoute.multiService: Whether to enable multi-service, defaults to false; not supported in Web mode
CreateRoute.trafficDistributionStrategy: Multi-service traffic distribution strategy, either ratio or model_name, required when multiService is true
CreateRoute.enableWeightAdjust: Whether to enable dynamic weight adjustment, applies only to multi-service ratio strategy, defaults to false
CreateRoute.targetService: Target service; pass an object for single-service, pass `List<TargetService>` for multi-service
CreateRoute.targetService.serviceSource: Service source: CCE, FIXED_IP, DNS_DOMAIN, CFC, AI_PROXY
CreateRoute.targetService.namespace: Namespace of the CCE service, required for CCE type
CreateRoute.targetService.servicePort: CCE service port, required for CCE type, range 1–65535
CreateRoute.targetService.loadBalanceAlgorithm: Load balancing algorithm: round-robin, least-conn, random, consistent-hash
CreateRoute.targetService.hashType: Consistent hash type: header, query_param, ip, cookie
CreateRoute.targetService.hashKey: Consistent hash key; pass an empty string when hashType is ip
CreateRoute.targetService.requestRatio: Traffic ratio for ratio strategy, sum of all services must equal 100
CreateRoute.targetService.weightFactor: Dynamic weight factor, must be a positive integer, defaults to 1
CreateRoute.targetService.modelName: Model name matched by the model_name strategy
CreateRoute.targetService.modelNameMode: AI_PROXY model name mode: passthrough, specify
CreateRoute.targetService.specifiedModelName: Fixed model name used when modelNameMode is specify
CreateRoute.rewrite: Standard path rewrite configuration; path is required when enabled is true
CreateRoute.rewrite.enabled: Whether to enable standard path rewrite
CreateRoute.rewrite.path: Rewritten path, required when enabled is true
CreateRoute.regexRewrite: Regex path rewrite configuration, takes priority over standard path rewrite
CreateRoute.regexRewrite.rewrite: Rewrite template, supports capture group references
CreateRoute.customHeaders: Custom request headers set when forwarding requests
CreateRoute.customHeaders.key: HTTP header name, must be unique within the same list
CreateRoute.skipSetHostHeader: Whether to skip automatic Host header injection for FIXED_IP or DNS_DOMAIN services
CreateRoute.authEnabled: Whether to enable consumer authentication, defaults to false
CreateRoute.allowedConsumers: List of consumer IDs allowed to access, at least one required when authEnabled is true
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit: Token rate limit configuration; at least one rule_item required when enabled is true
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.rule_name: Rule name generated by the server, returned in response only
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.enabled: Whether to enable token rate limiting
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.pre_reserve_remaining_rat: Dynamic pre-deduction trigger threshold, range 0–1; disabled when omitted or set to 0
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.pre_reserve_history_windo: Dynamic pre-deduction history window in seconds, defaults to 60
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.pre_reserve_safety_factor: Dynamic pre-deduction safety factor, must be >= 1, defaults to 1.0
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.pre_reserve_initial_token: Static pre-deduction for the first request, contains input and output
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.sliding_window_bucket_cou: Number of buckets in legacy mode, range 1–60, defaults to 6
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.pre_reserve_admission_bur: Burst seconds for smooth mode, range 1–60
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.pre_reserve_retry_jitter_: Retry jitter for smooth mode, range 0–1000 milliseconds
CreateRoute.tokenRateLimit.rule_items: List of token rate limit rules
CreateRoute.requestRateLimit: Request rate limit configuration; at least one rule_item required when enabled is true
CreateRoute.requestRateLimit.rule_name: Rule name generated by the server, returned in response only
CreateRoute.requestRateLimit.enabled: Whether to enable request rate limiting
CreateRoute.requestRateLimit.rule_items: List of request rate limit rules
CreateRoute.timeoutPolicy.enabled: Whether to enable the timeout policy
CreateRoute.timeoutPolicy.timeout: Timeout duration in seconds, required when enabled is true
CreateRoute.retryPolicy.enabled: Whether to enable the retry policy
CreateRoute.retryPolicy.retryConditions: Retry conditions, multiple conditions separated by commas
CreateRoute.corsPolicy.enabled: Whether to enable the CORS policy
CreateRoute.corsPolicy.allowOrigins: Allowed origins, each item contains matchType and value
CreateRoute.corsPolicy.maxAge: Preflight request cache duration in seconds
CreateRoute.responseHeaders.enabled: Whether to enable custom response headers
CreateRoute.fallbackConfig.specifiedModelName: Fixed model name used when modelNameMode is specify
